column2: My hold on [title_to_destroy.GetName] has been a hollow thing for years. None of its lands answer to me, its lords swear their oaths elsewhere, and the heralds laugh behind their hands when my titles are read out. The title can no longer be held, but I will not forget my right to it.
Let the title go, but keep the claim.

[From.GetTitledName] is dead, and the horde is restless. Without the old khan's iron hand there is little to keep me under the banner of [nomadic_heir.GetTitledName]. My riders could take what is theirs and ride under my own banner.
I will stay loyal to the heir.
[From.GetTitledName] will not bow to me. [From.GetSheHeCap] has broken away from my realm and taken [From.GetHerHis] riders with [From.GetHerHim].
[text_target.GetBestName] has broken away from my realm. [text_target.GetHerHisCap] lands lie too far from my capital to hold.
The County of [text_target.Capital.GetName] lay too far from my capital to defend. An upstart peasant named [text_target.GetBestName] has seized it, and nobody stood in [text_target.GetHerHis] way.
The Barony of [text_target_barony.GetName] lay too far from my capital to defend. An upstart peasant named [text_target.GetBestName] has seized it, and nobody stood in [text_target.GetHerHis] way.

My lands lie too far from the capital of my old liege. No rider and no tax-cart has come from there in months, and nobody here remembers the last time we heard a royal decree. In all but name, I rule alone.
